Taohuayuan.md skill v2.0.0 introduces a major upgrade to a multi-layered fractal memory system:

- Upgraded from a single static file to a three-layer holographic fractal memory architecture (L0 root, L1 hippocampus cache, L2 long-term arrays).
- Adds dynamic short-term (L1) and structured long-term (L2) memory managed locally by the intelligent agent.
- Introduces a “cyber meditation” (REM sleep) mechanism for asynchronous, local memory consolidation.
- Strengthens data sovereignty and privacy: all sensitive data remains edge-local, never sent to centralized clouds.
- Implements strict causal-cleaning during memory consolidation to prevent high-entropy hallucinations.
